summary: Kirk Field is a small general aviation airport serving the city of Paragould in northeastern Arkansas. It primarily supports private, recreational, and corporate aircraft operations, serving as a convenient alternative to the larger Jonesboro airport nearby. The facility reflects the region's agricultural and small-business aviation needs in Greene County.
